name: arest-mcp-registry
description: The MCP router's own store: which apps it serves, where each package is, which readings directories each app's check compiles, and whether to start it, read by the daemon's start with bun:sqlite. There is no `mcp` script: nothing calls a verb on the registry, so it composes no module and starts no server. There is no `check` script either: a check is the arest function compile-store, which the router calls itself (apps_check on 'registry'), setting the old store aside first and putting it back if the check fails.
